issue.title: Task block layout treats Gmail's 📬 REOPEN LOG as a loose note, so the first-req scoop and tidy file it under Notes

task_type_fields.impact: Any Gmail Task that was reopened by a reply and later gains its first requirement (capture `- [ ]`, Ctrl+], a merge into it once merges write reqs, or `bob task tidy -a`) has its REOPEN LOG buried inside its Notes drawer, out of the logs zone. That breaks REOPEN LOG history placement and its recovery dedupe, which looks for a direct-child REOPEN LOG. About four open vault tasks carry a REOPEN LOG today.

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning the merged-into-adds-a-req change: the vault migration trial showed tidy filing a REOPEN LOG under Notes, and the new merge path runs the same first-req scoop.

payload.description: Same task_block_layout zone rules; the merge-into-task change that resolves qc also runs the first-req scoop this bug corrupts
